sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You explain the individual cost shares rather than simply quoting an increase; it sounds like having your cost exposure understood matters to you. We want a competitive base price supported by transparent costs, with a longer contract providing continuity for both sides. What scope does that continuity create for reducing the base price, and could you share your cost-breakdown workbook in XLSX format so we can work through its elements together?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. To accommodate your request for a 24-month contract, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material risk. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please send us the competing offer you mentioned. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Your repeated emphasis on the alloy index clause suggests that protecting against long-term material risk is central to your offer. We want a durable agreement that supports continuity for you and competitive pricing for us. If we address that exposure through indexation, what further reduction in the base price can you make in return?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.84 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We have verified the recent decrease in PPI-C2431, though its impact on our overall cost basis is minimal. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause and the improved payment terms of 14 days. In return for these terms, we are pleased to reduce our base price to €5.00 per unit. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot provides a price of €5.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
